mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates easy monetary conditions, which can stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If 20-day S&P 500 returns do not show a significant positive correlation with low FEDFUNDS levels.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, which may boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are negative when UNRATE is below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) coupled with increasing federal funds rate indicates monetary tightening, which can negatively impact equity valuations and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are positive despite rising CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) may lead to inflation concerns, prompting tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns remain positive despite CPIAUCSL increase in late-cycle.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a strong economy, which can lead to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are negative when GDPC1 shows growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong economic activity, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are negative when INDPRO exceeds 105.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing employment (PAYEMS) and decreasing unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a strong labor market, boosting consumer demand and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are negative despite positive labor market indicators.

mechanism_narrative: During economic expansions, an increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are negative when HOUST exceeds 1100 during expansion.
